READ THIS: Condition Statement – “Metal Body Parts”
This listing is for Metal Body Parts. All Metal Body Parts may contain Dings, Scrapes, Surface Rust or Factory Spot Welds, which are Considered Normal. These Parts Can Not be Painted Unless Professionally Prepared. Preparation Includes Cleaning, Sanding, Filling, Priming and Possibly Other Work Based on Final Use Requirements. While this frame is for the Left Hand Drive, occasionally the fitment for wiper motor is not aligned correctly. Frame may require to be tapped and filled back in. Ask Questions before buying. Purchasing of this Part Constitutes Buyer’s Acknowledgement of Reading and Acceptance of the Above Condition Statement. There are no returns allowed on this item.
